routes.name: Visa-free entry, up to 1 year
routes.summary: Citizens of the 94 countries on the government list (including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, South Korea, most of the EU and many others) can enter and stay up to one full year without a visa. The list was amended on 2026-02-24 (Ordinance 80), so check your passport against the current official list. Insurance is required at entry.

other: Must be a citizen of a listed country. The English text on matsne.gov.ge still shows 94 countries with the one-year rule, but the 2026-02-24 amendment (Ordinance 80) could not be read in detail, so confirm your passport on the current list.
EU citizens can enter with a passport or a national ID card that shows name, surname, date of birth and photo.

Since 2026-01-01 every tourist needs health and accident insurance of at least 30,000 GEL covering the whole stay (arrival and departure dates included), in Georgian or English, from a Georgian or foreign insurer. Exempt: diplomatic and special visa or passport holders, accredited diplomatic staff, people entering under international treaties, and international road freight and passenger drivers.

stay.note: One full year per the ordinance notes and Article 10(3) of the law. No 2026 change to the one-year length could be confirmed.

documents: Health and accident insurance, at least 30,000 GEL, covering the full stay
steps: Show passport and policy at the border

sources.label: Ordinance 255: countries allowed visa-free for one year (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Visa-free entry, 90 days in 180
routes.summary: Anyone who does not need a short-term visa can stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period (Article 10 of the law). Nationalities outside the one-year list that get visa-free entry, and some holders of other countries' visas or residence permits, fall under this rule.

other: Which nationalities get visa-free entry on the 90-day rule, and which visas or permits count, is set by government ordinance and was not confirmed. The law only says the ordinance sets the list.

Holders of a valid UAE multiple-entry visa or residence permit (one year validity, with exceptions for 17 listed nationalities) can enter visa-free for 90 days, per the Georgian embassy in the UAE. Other residence-based lists exist, see the official portal.
Insurance of at least 30,000 GEL is required at entry since 2026-01-01.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Short-stay visa (C1) via e-Visa
routes.summary: Short-term tourist or business visa for people who need a visa. You apply and pay online on the e-Visa portal and get it by email. The law has short-stay categories C1 (tourism), C2 (visiting relatives and friends), C3 (business meetings, conferences, journalism, drivers) and C4 (humanitarian, treatment, pilgrimage). C1 allows 90 days per the embassy page.

other: Fee, processing time and full document list were not confirmed. The Georgian embassy in the UAE lists a USD 20 or AED 75 service fee for its own applications, which may differ from the portal.
Documents listed by the embassy include insurance above 30,000 GEL, accommodation proof, return ticket and three months of bank statements.

stay.note: C1 is 90 days per the embassy page.

documents: Travel or health insurance covering over 30,000 GEL

sources.label: Georgia e-Visa portal

routes.name: Transit (no visa in airside transit area, or T visa)
routes.summary: You can pass through Georgia without a visa if you stay in the designated transit area of the airport, station or port, have a document for your onward country, and stay no more than 10 days. Passengers on flights that cross Georgian airspace without landing also need no visa if a permit was obtained. Otherwise a T category transit visa (10 days) is needed.

other: Must not leave the transit area. Needs a document showing the right to enter your destination country.
Whether your nationality also needs an airside transit visa is not set in the law text we read.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Long-stay visa D1 (work and business)
routes.summary: D1 immigration visa for people coming to carry out entrepreneurial activity under the Law on Entrepreneurs, or to work, once they have the right to labor activity. It lets you enter and then get a work residence permit.

other: Required documents, fees and processing time were not confirmed. See the documents list linked from the embassy visa page.

routes.name: Long-stay visa D3 (study)
routes.summary: D3 immigration visa for adults coming to study or do research at an authorized Georgian institution, or to study in an international program. Minors use D6.

other: Documents, fees and processing time were not confirmed.

routes.name: Long-stay visa D4 (family reunification)
routes.summary: D4 immigration visa for family reunification.

other: Who qualifies, documents, fees and processing time were not confirmed.

routes.name: Long-stay visa D5 (property owner)
routes.summary: D5 visa for owners of Georgian real property (not agricultural land) worth over USD 150,000 in GEL. It also covers the owner's spouse and children. Value must be certified by an assessor of an accredited body.

investment.note: Non-agricultural real property, value certified by an accredited assessor

other: Fees and processing time were not confirmed.

routes.name: Work residence permit
routes.summary: Temporary residence permit giving the right to work in Georgia. First issued for 6 months to 1 year and can be extended, up to 12 years in total.

other: The documents you need are set by government ordinance and were not confirmed. Fees and processing time were not confirmed either.

stay.note: First permit 6 months to 1 year. Extensions allowed up to 12 years in total.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Study residence permit
routes.summary: Temporary residence permit for adults studying a higher or vocational program at an authorized Georgian institution. First issued for 6 months to 1 year, extendable up to 12 years.

other: Enrollment rules are set by law and government ordinance and were not read in full. Study years do not count toward permanent residence. Fees and processing time were not confirmed.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Family reunification residence permit
routes.summary: Temporary residence permit for family members of someone who holds a Georgian residence permit. First issued for 6 months to 1 year, extendable up to 12 years. Spouses of citizens use a separate permit.

other: Family members in the law are a spouse, child and parent, plus dependents and people under guardianship. Documents, fees and processing time were not confirmed.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: IT sector residence permit
routes.summary: Residence permit for IT workers and IT individual entrepreneurs (small business status) earning at least USD 25,000 a year with 2+ years of IT experience, and for people authorized to manage and represent international IT companies. Family members are included. First issued for 3 years.

other: At least 2 years of IT experience plus a certificate of annual income of at least USD 25,000 in GEL (workers and small-business entrepreneurs). Managers of international IT companies need a document proving their authority. Covered IT activities, fees and processing time are set by ordinance and were not confirmed.

stay.note: 3 years for the first permit. The law's general 12-year extension rule does not list this permit, so renewal terms were not confirmed.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Investor residence permit
routes.summary: Residence permit for you and your family if you invest at least USD 300,000 (in GEL) in Georgia, or own non-agricultural property worth over USD 300,000. First issued for 5 years, then extendable 3 years at a time up to 12 years. Can lead to an unlimited permit.

other: Property value is certified by an accredited assessor. For the investment route, annual turnover must be at least USD 50,000 in year 1, USD 100,000 in year 2 and USD 120,000 in years 3 to 5, or the permit ends. Property route holders must keep the property. Family means spouse, minor child and fully dependent persons.

stay.note: 5 years first, then 3-year extensions up to 12 years total.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Short-term property owner residence permit
routes.summary: Short-term permit for owners of non-agricultural property worth over USD 150,000 (in GEL), plus spouse and children. Renewed one year at a time, up to 12 years in total. It ends if you lose ownership.

other: Value is certified by an accredited assessor. Fees and processing time were not confirmed.

stay.note: Extended 1 year at a time, up to 12 years in total.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Unlimited residence permit (investors)
routes.summary: Permanent permit for investor permit holders and their family. Investment route: turnover of at least USD 50,000 in year 1, USD 100,000 in year 2 and USD 120,000 in years 3 to 5. Property route: keep ownership of the property for 5 years after getting the investor permit.

other: Apply before the 5-year investor permit expires. Investment route needs proof of the year-5 turnover of at least USD 120,000. Property route needs a Public Registry certificate showing 5 years of ownership. Fees and processing time were not confirmed.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Permanent residence permit
routes.summary: Permanent residence permit for a minor child of a citizen, a parent of a minor citizen, a spouse of a citizen after 5 years on the spouse permit, or anyone with 10 years of residence on a temporary permit. Study, medical treatment and diplomatic mission years do not count.

other: Fees, documents and processing time were not confirmed.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Special residence permit
routes.summary: Special permit for suspected victims of human trafficking, people named in Article 60, compatriots living abroad, and people a government member proposes for a permit. 1 year first, up to 5 years on a government member's initiative, extendable up to 12 years.

other: Conditions for compatriots and the other groups are set by other rules and were not confirmed. Fees and processing time were not confirmed.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Asylum and refugee protection
routes.summary: Asylum is handled under Georgian law on international protection. Holders of a temporary protection permit can stay visa-free for the permit's validity. Apply through the official migration authorities.

other: Process details not confirmed. Contact online@sda.gov.ge or +995 32 2 40 10 10.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)
Migration Department, Ministry of Internal Affairs (sda.gov.ge)

routes.name: Citizenship by naturalization
routes.summary: Regular route needs 10 years of lawful residence, Georgian language, history and basic law knowledge, and a job, property or business in Georgia. Stateless persons need 5 years.

other: The law has a 2026-06-25 amendment (1820-Vმს-XIმპ) and matsne.gov.ge says its consolidated English version is still being updated, so the 2025 text was used. Confirm current rules.

citizenship.note: Georgia generally allows one citizenship. Dual citizenship only in exceptional cases (presidential grants) or with state consent given before taking the other citizenship.

sources.label: Organic Law on Georgian Citizenship (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Citizenship by marriage (simplified)
routes.summary: Spouse of a Georgian citizen can apply through the simplified procedure after 5 years of continuous lawful residence, with language and history/law knowledge. Marriage alone does not give citizenship.

other: The law has a 2026-06-25 amendment (1820-Vმს-XIმპ) and matsne.gov.ge says its consolidated English version is still being updated, so the 2025 text was used. Confirm current rules.

sources.label: Organic Law on Georgian Citizenship (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Citizenship by descent (parent)
routes.summary: A child is a citizen at birth if a parent is a Georgian citizen. Descent from earlier ancestors is not a standalone route, but can count as a ground for an exceptional presidential grant (ancestors up to five generations).

other: The law has a 2026-06-25 amendment (1820-Vმს-XIმპ) and matsne.gov.ge says its consolidated English version is still being updated, so the 2025 text was used. Confirm current rules.

sources.label: Organic Law on Georgian Citizenship (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Exceptional citizenship by the President (incl. investment)
routes.summary: The President can grant citizenship for exceptional merit or in the state interest. Grounds include a substantial investment, sporting, science or art achievements, or a homeland connection. Dual citizenship is allowed here.

other: No investment amount stated on the page we read. Discretionary, not a guaranteed route.
The law has a 2026-06-25 amendment (1820-Vმს-XIმპ) and matsne.gov.ge says its consolidated English version is still being updated, so the 2025 text was used. Confirm current rules.

sources.label: Organic Law on Georgian Citizenship (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Long-stay visa D2 (freelancers, interns, volunteers, cultural and sports missions)
routes.summary: D2 immigration visa for freelancers, people on scientific, sports, cultural or educational missions, interns, volunteers and media workers on official duty. The law defines a freelancer as someone who carries out professional duties independently, in favor of other people or the public.

other: Documents, fees and processing time were not confirmed.

sources.label: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, consolidated 25/06/2026 (matsne.gov.ge)

routes.name: Residence permit for the spouse of a citizen
routes.summary: Permit for the spouse of a Georgian citizen. First issued for 1 year, extended 2 years at a time, up to 5 years in total. If the marriage continues after 5 years, you get a permanent residence permit. An interagency commission checks the marriage.

other: Documents, fees and processing time were not confirmed.

stay.note: 1 year first, then 2-year extensions, 5 years maximum before permanent residence.
